before: Another study focuses on Familial Mediterranean fever, a condition that mainly affects people of Mediterranean descent with a higher incidence in the Turkish, Jewish, Arabic, and Armenian populations [1].
The same study reported allele frequencies for additional MEFV mutations including E148Q, M680I, V726A, A744S, R761H, P706P, E167D, M694I, and K695R [2].

A study of hemoglobin variants noted that African, Asian, and Mediterranean populations and their descendants are among the most affected by hemoglobin disorders, which are the most common single-gene disorders in humans [3].

Another study focuses on Familial Mediterranean fever, a condition that mainly affects people of Mediterranean descent with a higher incidence in the Turkish, Jewish, Arabic, and Armenian populations [6].
The same study reported allele frequencies for additional MEFV mutations including E148Q, M680I, V726A, A744S, R761H, P706P, E167D, M694I, and K695R [7].

A study of hemoglobin variants noted that African, Asian, and Mediterranean populations and their descendants are among the most affected by hemoglobin disorders, which are the most common single-gene disorders in humans [8].
